name: rule 1: a parameter with a function type may be called

name: rule 1: call-of-parameter, fn-hint: a parameter written as a name
source: const g = (xs, f) => f(xs); 1

diagnostics.message: f is a parameter; to call it, give it a function type, as f: (x: int) => int

name: rule 1: call-of-parameter, fn-hint: a parameter with a program type

diagnostics.message: n is a parameter; to call it, give it a function type, as n: (x: int) => int

name: rule 1: call-of-parameter, default: a parameter with a default

diagnostics.message: f is a value, not a function, and cannot be called

diagnostics.message: run is a value, not a function, and cannot be called
